dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there! I'm looking for a new pair of shoes. I've got a budget between $100 and $200, and I'm hoping to find something that's decent quality — at least a 1 out of 5 average rating. I don't really have a specific style in mind, so what do you have that's in my price range?
dialogue.agent:
Great, I found some solid options in your price range! All of these have excellent ratings. Here are some top picks:

1. **ARIAT Women's Fatbaby Heritage Waterproof Western Boot** — $129.95, ⭐ 4.9/5 (3 reviews) — Waterproof, comfy, lightweight western boots
2. **ROCKROOSTER Bedrock - Mens Urban Waterproof Anti-Fatigue Outdoor Hiking Boots** — $109.99, ⭐ 4.9/5 (11 reviews) — Waterproof hiking boots with anti-fatigue tech
3. **Brooks Women's Hyperion Max Neutral Running Shoe** — $169.95, ⭐ 4.8/5 (5 reviews) — Performance running shoe
4. **Oboz Women's Bridger Mid B-Dry Waterproof Hiking Boots** — $165.00, ⭐ 4.8/5 (262 reviews) — Hiking boots with tons of reviews
5. **Mephisto Men's Sagun Sandal** — $161.65, ⭐ 4.9/5 — Premium leather sandals

What kind of activities will you be using the shoes for? That would help me narrow down the perfect pair for you!

products.title: Newton Running Distance S 9
products.description: Newton Distance S 9 Running Shoes A staple racer to many, including 3X Ironman World Champion Craig Alexander. This stability model of the award-winning Distance features light minimalistic overlays and dual-density foam for a high-performance feel. Ultra Breathable Mesh Upper The Newton Distance 9 running shoe is built for speed. Engineered with an ultra lightweight, ultra-breathable mesh upper the Distance 9 will have you clocking up the miles and hitting new records without feeling the heat. As cool air permeates the mesh, any uncomfortable heat build-up is removed creating a regulated temperature and a healthy environment that feet can thrive in. The new minimalistic overlays offer support without adding unnecessary bulk or weight and work in tandem with a traditional lace closure for a secure, locked down fit. The no-sew toe cap eliminates discomfort from chaffing and rubbing for a distraction-free ride. Newtonium Cushioned Midsole Featuring a full foot Newtonium cushioned midsole, cushioned lugs in the forefoot and heel provide full-foot cushioned protection, attenuating shock impact where you strike down the most alleviating stress on the joints and reducing fatigue. Working in tandem with the Newtonium cushioned midsole is the action/reaction technology providing exceptional energy return. Generated by the active movement of the cushioned lugs, the active/reactive technology creates a trampoline-like effect responding to your every step with quicker bounce-back for effective and highly responsive energy return. Constructed with a second density medial support the Distance S 9 provides a firmer medial side post to prevent overpronation during running. SHARC Outsole The Distance 9 shoes SHARC Outsole consists of a high abrasion and high-density rubber providing increased and enhanced floor fighting traction in both dry and wet conditions.

products.title: Oboz Women's Bridger Mid B-Dry Waterproof Hiking Boots, Wide Walnut 6.5

dialogue.user: Thanks for the list! I'm not really looking for sandals or western boots, so let's skip those. The running shoes and hiking boots sound more like what I'd be interested in. Can you tell me more about the Brooks Women's Hyperion Max and the Oboz Bridger Mid? What are their key features, especially in terms of comfort and durability?
dialogue.agent:
Here's a detailed look at both:

---

### **Brooks Women's Hyperion Max Neutral Running Shoe** — $169.95 | ⭐ 4.8/5 (5 reviews)

**Comfort & Features:**
- **DNA FLASH cushioning** — nitrogen-infused foam that's lightweight, responsive, and adapts to your stride
- **Stretch woven upper** with 3D Fit Print for a secure, breathable fit
- Curved heel/toe design to propel you forward
- **Green Rubber outsole** for fast, effortless transitions

**What reviewers say:** They're super light, comfortable, and one reviewer says they actually run faster in them. High sole engages the calves.

---

### **Oboz Women's Bridger Mid B-Dry Waterproof Hiking Boots** — $165.00 | ⭐ 4.8/5 (262 reviews — very popular!)

**Comfort & Features:**
- **Waterproof** nubuck leather & abrasion-resistant fabric with B-Dry breathable membrane
- **O FIT Insole** — plush foam with structured arch & heel cup
- **Dual-density EVA midsole** for extra cushioning
- **Nylon shank** for stability on uneven terrain
- **TPU heel counter** for long-lasting support
- Rubber toe cap and multi-directional lugs for great traction

---

So to sum it up:
- **Brooks Hyperion Max** — Best if you're running or want something light, fast, and cushioned
- **Oboz Bridger Mid** — Best for hiking or outdoor activities with waterproofing, durability, and lots of customer backing (262 reviews!)

Which sounds more like what you're looking for? Or do you use the shoes for a mix of both?

result.title: Brooks Women’s Hyperion Max Neutral Running Shoe
result.features:
Imported
Rubber sole
THIS WOMEN’S SHOE IS FOR: The Hyperion Max provides neutral support for runners who want to train their fastest and need performance gear to get them ready for race day.
SOFT CUSHIONING: The midsole is configured with nitrogen-infused, lightweight DNA FLASH cushioning that is highly responsive and returns energy while adapting to your stride.
SECURE FIT: The stretch woven upper and 3D Fit Print provide extra structure to hold your foot in place while also providing optimum airflow.
PROTECTION: Outfitted with substantial midsole foam to help absorb impact through your toughest workouts — so you can take on another hard training session sooner.
QUICK TRANSITIONS: The heel and toe of the midsole are uniquely curved to propel you forward while the Green Rubber outsole helps with fast, effortless transitions.

result.title: Oboz Women's Bridger Mid B-Dry Waterproof Hiking Boots, Wide Walnut 6.5
result.features:
WIDE WIDTH. Upper is made out of waterproof nubuck leather and abrasion-resistant fabric. Moisture-wicking nylon mesh lining.
B-Dry Breathable Membrane blocks moisture from the outside while letting it escape from the interior. Rubber toe protection cap. PU heel pod uses an asymmetrical shape for ergonomic support.
O FIT Insole combines plush foam, a structured high-density heel and arch cup, and a moisture-wicking Soft Touch top layer with medium-density EVA foam throughout.. Dual-density EVA midsole for extra cushioning. Non-marking rubber outsole uses a combination of side and 4mm lugs to offer multi-directional traction and a high-friction grip in wet and dry conditions.
Board-lasted design. Granite Peak rubber outsole, with a molded toe cap and heel kick, offers abrasion resistance. Lace-up closure.
Nylon shank gives you better stability. TPU heel counter enhances the pair with long-lasting support, improved motion control, and a stronger heel lock. 5 in. shaft with a 1 in. heel.

top_reviews.title: Great walking shoes!
top_reviews.text: These have a high sole so they really engage the calves.

top_reviews.title: I really do run faster in these.
top_reviews.text: They are built differently and I wondered about them.  I wore them in the house for a bit before committing to run outside. I LOVE them. They are super light. I do not wear them every run as I really do run faster in them so they are great for a few times a week when i want some speed work. I really like the look of them too- they "look" fast. Lol.

top_reviews.title: It’s very comfortable shoes, and I recommend it!

dialogue.user:
Both sound like great options! I'm not a runner though, so I think the Oboz hiking boots might be more practical for me — they sound really durable and comfortable for all-day wear. Since they have 262 reviews and a 4.8 rating, they seem like a safe bet.

I think I'm satisfied with what I've heard. The Oboz Women's Bridger Mid B-Dry Waterproof Hiking Boots fit my budget at $165, have great ratings well above my 1/5 minimum, and seem durable and comfortable. I'll go ahead and purchase those!
